raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

[InferenceX #4680](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4680) adds the MI355X AgentX lane `qwen3.8next-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp`. InferenceX requires its production serving settings on a merged SGLang cookbook page before the PR merges. The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next page has no command for this lane: the Deploy panel's MI355X cells serve the BF16 and FP8 checkpoints at TP8 without MTP, and the generated AgentX explorer has no AMD lanes.

## Modifications

- `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx`: under Agentic Long-Context Deployment, after the `<AgentX>` explorer, add an MI355X subsection in the form of the GLM-5.3 (#46825) and Muse Spark Open (#45689) ones. It names the pinned image with its digest and gives one `sglang serve` command for `amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8-PLEFP8` at TP1 with NEXTN 3/1/4, plus bullets for the settings a reader would otherwise have to guess: the PLE table offload and the FP8 dtype override it requires, `SGLANG_AITER_HONOR_EXPLICIT_MEM_FRACTION=1`, the batch limits per concurrency, and the non-thinking chat default.
- Not changed: the Deploy panel config, the engines, and the generated `docs/src/snippets/agentx/Qwen/qwen3.8-flash-next.jsx`. The sa-infx-cookbook sync generates that file, and none of the generated AgentX files carries an AMD lane yet.

## Source of truth

- InferenceX PR: https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4680 (open, review decision `CHANGES_REQUESTED`; see Open items)
- InferenceX head reviewed: `b0dfbf2d243d60033ce3522521fc74dc25d8cf2b`, rechecked unchanged before opening this PR
- Config key and recipe: `qwen3.8next-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp` in `inferencex-e2e/configs/amd-master.yaml`, and `inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/qwen3.8next/sglang/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml` (`base` plus `override_c1`, `c2`, `c4`, `c8`, `c12`, `c16`)
- SGLang main base: `7146002be8a7c65a482c27778eadb21fcf34034d`
- Sweep and eval evidence:
  - Full sweep [run 41114439370](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41114439370), attempt 1, at the reviewed head: conclusion `success`. The agentic jobs at c1, c2, c4, c8, c12 and c16 and the c16 eval-only job all succeeded. GSM8K (lm-eval, 1,319 questions) at c16: `em_strict` 0.9666 ± 0.0049.
  - Earlier e2e [run 41101486925](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41101486925) at `05fb5ae45`: c8, c12, c16 and the c16 eval succeeded. Its recipe differs from the head only by the c1, c2 and c4 overrides the head adds.
  - The PR has no `/use` comment yet. I did not run any InferenceX benchmark.

## Where the supplied selector lands

The published Deploy selection `hw=mi355x&variant=default&quant=bf16&strategy=balanced&nodes=single&pleOffload=auto` is a different lane. It renders `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` (BF16) at `--tp-size 8` and `--page-size 32` without MTP, on `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:qwen38flashnext`. The PLE Offload row is hidden on AMD, so `pleOffload=auto` adds no flag there. #4680 serves the AMD MXFP4 checkpoint at TP1 for an AgentX workload, so this PR adds it to the Agentic Long-Context section and leaves that cell alone.

The Deploy panel has no MXFP4 option for this model. #36919 (open, last updated 2026-09-12) would add one for a different checkpoint (`amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4`, TP8·EP8) in the Deploy panel. It does not cover #4680's lane. On this page it edits the install notes and the precision table of an older revision, not the Agentic Long-Context section this PR adds to.

## Coverage

The six #4680 arms differ only in their batch limits. Normalized against the cookbook command (aliases resolved, JSON values compared parsed), every arm has 29 exact matches, 6 settings the image resolves identically, 4 intentional exclusions, and 0 missing, 0 conflicting and 0 extra settings.

| #4680 arm | `--max-running-requests` = `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` | Cookbook source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `override_c1` | 2 | Batch limits bullet | match |
| `override_c2` | 4 | Batch limits bullet | match |
| `override_c4` | 8 | Batch limits bullet | match |
| `override_c8` | 16 | Batch limits bullet | match |
| `override_c12` | 24 | Batch limits bullet | match |
| `override_c16` | 32 | Command | match |

Shared by every arm, and in the command as written: image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi35x-20261030@sha256:1ff42c238adfca9a55e8d3d3dc859a4e4e88b23e7f9340e86d17ff042b933bda`, `--model-path amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8-PLEFP8`, `--trust-remote-code`, `--tp-size 1`, `--quantization quark`, `--attention-backend aiter`, `--page-size 64`, `--kv-cache-dtype auto`, `--mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16`, `--ple-offload-embedding`, `--json-model-override-args '{"text_config": {"ple_embedding_dtype": "float8_e4m3fn"}}'`, NEXTN 3/1/4, `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.9`, `--chunked-prefill-size 16384`, `--scheduler-recv-interval 10`, `--stream-interval 50`, `--tokenizer-worker-num 6`, `--reasoning-parser qwen3`, `--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder`, `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'`, `--model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load": true}'`, `--watchdog-timeout 1200`, `SGLANG_AITER_HONOR_EXPLICIT_MEM_FRACTION=1` and `AITER_GDR_FLYDSL=1`.

Recipe settings without a cookbook line, because the image resolves them identically (checked at SGLang `17e94c4677`, the image's build):

- `--served-model-name` and `--tokenizer-path`: both default to `--model-path`.
- `--data-parallel-size 1` and `--expert-parallel-size 1`: defaults.
- `SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1`: #27964 (Retire Spec V1) removed it from `environ.py`, and nothing in the image reads it.
- `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=NONE`: `quick_all_reduce.py` defaults to `NONE`, and TP1 runs no all-reduce.

#4680 does not pin a model revision. The checkpoint's HF `main` has been `bd6e49d9abfe0ce1da53a45593daaee83580035b` since 2026-10-15, before every #4680 run.

## Intentionally excluded

- `--enable-metrics` and `--enable-cache-report`: telemetry that the benchmark client reads (`AIPERF_REQUIRED_SERVER_METRIC_PREFIX`). The AgentX sync drops both from the NVIDIA Qwen3.8 lanes as well.
- `SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=1800`: the recipe's own comment says it outlasts AIPerf's 300 s client connection pool.
- `PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1`: container hygiene.
- `benchmark.env` (`AIPERF_APPLY_CHAT_TEMPLATE`, `AIPERF_REQUIRED_SERVER_METRIC_PREFIX`), the per-point `CONC` and `KV_OFFLOADING`, and `dram-utilization: 0.80`, which has no effect with `kv-offloading: none`.
- Synthetic acceptance: the harness injects the golden acceptance length (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`); the recipe does not set it, so it is not part of the command.

## Open items on InferenceX #4680

- The bot review's 🔴 finding on `default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'` (thinking-off serving measured against the thinking-on golden acceptance length and the NVIDIA lanes) has no reply yet. This PR documents the head as it stands. If #4680 drops or changes that line, the command and the Thinking bullet need the same change before this PR merges.
- The review decision is still `CHANGES_REQUESTED`. Both requested changes (no INT8 quick-reduce, and the low-concurrency points) are in the head, but no re-review has happened yet.
- The page's section 2.1 says thinking cannot be turned off. This checkpoint's chat template, which is identical to that of `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next`, honors `enable_thinking: false`, and the smoke test below confirms it. I left section 2.1 unchanged to keep this PR to the MI355X subsection.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`: pass.
- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: pass. `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: 52/52 pass. `node --test .github/scripts/pr-title.test.cjs`: 98/98 pass, and the workflow's title script accepts this title.
- `SKIP=no-commit-to-branch pre-commit run --files docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx`: pass (codespell, whitespace, end of file, merge conflicts, private key). I did not run `--all-files` locally.
- `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` with mint 4.2.559, the CI pin: pass. `mint validate`: pass.
- Rendered page (`mint dev` with headless Chromium, `main` and this branch each served alone):
  - The new subsection renders under its own anchor, and its command text equals the MDX source.
  - Deploy panel: 176 selections (44 cells × 4 PLE Offload values, the supplied selection included) render the same text on `main` and on this branch. The AgentX explorer renders the same on both.
  - The only heading added is the new H3. Neither side logs console or page errors. All five external links in the subsection return 200.
- Arm comparison: a script resolved the six arms at the reviewed head (`base` merged with each override) and compared each with the cookbook command and the batch-limit bullet. The result is in Coverage above.
- Argument parsing in the pinned image: the exact command parses with the image's own `ServerArgs` (`sglang 0.5.23.dev20261030+g17e94c4677`).
- Smoke test of the command as written, on one MI355X with the pinned image (the AMD GPU page's Docker flags without `--privileged`, passing one GPU's `/dev/dri` nodes; HF snapshot `bd6e49d9`):
  - The startup log shows `SGLANG_AITER_HONOR_EXPLICIT_MEM_FRACTION is set, so mem_fraction_static=0.900 is used as-is`, 82.42 GB of target weights on the GPU with the N-gram table in pinned host memory (Docker's default memlock limit was enough), a 3,587,904-token KV pool, and target-verify, draft-decode and draft-extend CUDA graphs captured up to batch size 32.
  - `/get_server_info` reports `ple_offload_embedding=True` with the `pinned` backend, `mem_fraction_static=0.9`, `max_running_requests=32`, `cuda_graph_max_bs_decode=32`, EAGLE (from NEXTN) 3/1/4, ReplaySSM on, the `qwen3` and `qwen3_coder` parsers, and `default_chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': False}`.
  - A default chat request returns no `reasoning_content`; with `chat_template_kwargs: {"enable_thinking": true}` it returns reasoning. A `get_weather` tool request returns `finish_reason=tool_calls` with the parsed call.
  - The same command without `--json-model-override-args` stops at weight load with `ValueError: fp8 PLE auto-switch is unsupported with ple_offload_embedding`, as the PLE offload bullet says.

## Accuracy Tests

None for this documentation change. InferenceX's GSM8K result at c16 on the reviewed head is listed under Source of truth. As a sanity check of the command as written, the first 200 GSM8K test questions through `/v1/chat/completions` (greedy, thinking off by the server default, answer taken from a final "The answer is N" line) scored 0.980 on one MI355X.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None; the speed numbers are in the linked InferenceX run. During the sanity check, decode batches with 32 running requests ran in CUDA graphs with a real MTP accept length of about 3.5 of 4 draft tokens on non-thinking output.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Not applicable: documentation only.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). The measured results are in the linked InferenceX runs; the local GSM8K run above is a sanity check only.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Scope

Documentation only: one new subsection in `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx`. No SGLang runtime code, Deploy panel config, engine, generated AgentX data or InferenceX file changed.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -82,6 +82,52 @@ import { agentx } from "/src/snippets/agentx/Qwen/qwen3.8-flash-next.jsx";
 
 <AgentX data={agentx} />
 
+### MI355X deployment measured with SemiAnalysis InferenceX
+
+AMD's Quark MXFP4 checkpoint with NEXTN MTP on one MI355X (TP1) and GPU-resident KV, benchmarked in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) ([InferenceX #4680](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4680)) at concurrency 1–16.
+
+- **Container image.** `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi35x-20261030` (`sha256:1ff42c238adfca9a55e8d3d3dc859a4e4e88b23e7f9340e86d17ff042b933bda`, the image tested in InferenceX, run without patches). This dated nightly is built from SGLang `main` at [`17e94c4677`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/17e94c4677d7beb58a89b104fd61b3768994e45e) with AITER [`285579b6`](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/commit/285579b6211b0da30f35b91a890c29c823597cd1).
+- **Checkpoint.** [`amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8-PLEFP8`](https://huggingface.co/amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8-PLEFP8) has MXFP4 MoE experts (the MTP head's included), FP8 attention and an FP8 N-gram table, 116 GiB in all.
+- **PLE offload.** `--ple-offload-embedding` keeps the 47.7 GiB FP8 N-gram table in pinned host memory, which leaves about 82 GB of weights on the GPU. On ROCm the server leaves it off unless you pass the flag. Offloading this checkpoint also needs the `--json-model-override-args` value, which declares the table's FP8 storage up front; without it the server stops at load with `fp8 PLE auto-switch is unsupported with ple_offload_embedding`.
+- **Memory fraction.** For models with a context above 8,192 tokens, the aiter attention backend multiplies `--mem-fraction-static` by 0.85. `SGLANG_AITER_HONOR_EXPLICIT_MEM_FRACTION=1` keeps 0.9 as given.
+- **Batch limits.** Set `--max-running-requests` and `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` to twice the concurrency, so request bursts above it still decode in a captured graph: 2, 4, 8, 16, 24 and 32 at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 16. The command below uses concurrency 16.
+- **Thinking.** `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'` makes non-thinking the default: the chat template opens each reply with an empty `<think></think>` block. A request turns thinking back on with `"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": true}`.
+
+```bash Command
+SGLANG_AITER_HONOR_EXPLICIT_MEM_FRACTION=1 \
+AITER_GDR_FLYDSL=1 \
+sglang serve \
+  --model-path amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8-PLEFP8 \
+  --trust-remote-code \
+  --tp-size 1 \
+  --quantization quark \
+  --attention-backend aiter \
+  --page-size 64 \
+  --kv-cache-dtype auto \
+  --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 \
+  --ple-offload-embedding \
+  --json-model-override-args '{"text_config": {"ple_embedding_dtype": "float8_e4m3fn"}}' \
+  --speculative-algorithm NEXTN \
+  --speculative-num-steps 3 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
+  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
+  --enable-linear-replayssm-spec \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
+  --chunked-prefill-size 16384 \
+  --max-running-requests 32 \
+  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 \
+  --scheduler-recv-interval 10 \
+  --stream-interval 50 \
+  --tokenizer-worker-num 6 \
+  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
+  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
+  --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}' \
+  --model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load": true}' \
+  --watchdog-timeout 1200 \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30000
+```
+
 ## 1. Model Introduction
 
 **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next** is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model released as an early preview of the architecture Qwen4 is being built on — the same role Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5, whose hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design then carried through the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. Qwen is publishing the architectural changes ahead of the full Qwen4 family so the community can evaluate them independently.
